reason: The Nigerian Exchange Limited publishes no bid and no offer in its free market data. The Daily Official List (Equities) carries the official open, the official close, the current market price, the business done quantity, the 52 week high and low, dividend dates, EPS and P/E, and nothing about resting orders. The web Equities Price List carries previous closing price, opening, high, low, close, change, trades, volume and value. Bid and offer are part of the NGX licensed real time feed, delivered to subscribers.
